about: BATCH 14 B2, the fit and the even spread of his FB-06 pick and card 86 pick A (the colours and style row the last item, spaced like everything else; the 320x568 overflow fixed first). Graded by gate 236 (TC-R413..414) on a trial bundle in the player view: a returning and a brand-new player at 320x568, 375x761, 375x812 and 390x844. Three ways it could come undone are each caught: the spread dropped (packed at the top again), the phone fit dropped (320x568 scrolls again), and pick B instead of his A (only the colours row pinned to the foot). NOT COVERED: icon C on the Play tile (the next part of the job), the dev view's extra rows (gate 49 pins those), a wide or sideways Home, his look on the phone.

breaks.name: packed-at-the-top-again
breaks.why: the free space is not shared out: Home is packed at the top with the empty band under it again

breaks.name: overflow-at-320-again
breaks.why: Home is not fitted to the window on a phone: at 320x568 a returning player's Home runs 56px past the screen again

breaks.name: the-last-row-pinned-to-the-foot
breaks.why: the option he did not pick (B): the colours and style row alone is pushed to the foot and the gaps above it stay as they were, so they are not even
